text: Without strong external pressure from existing regulatory structures and a distributed jurisdiction responsive to that pressure, the anonymity of smart contracting will ultimately undermine the coding of existing legal rules into smart contracts.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Craig Calcaterra, Crypto Transaction Dispute Resolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2992962
abstract: Without strong external pressures from existing regulatory structures and a distributed jurisdiction for crypto transactions that is responsive to such pressure, the anonymity of smart contracting will ultimately undermine the coding of existing legal rules into smart contracts.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: anonymous parties transacting through Ethereum and virtual private networks
